fields.description: Issue includes an editorial campaign opposing the appointment of John Rowland as Miami chief of police, linking the controversy to "Little Tammany" and Vernon Hawthorne and discussing crime and political influence in Dade County. Other coverage addresses gambling and enforcement against slot machines and marble boards, criticism of Miami telephone rates and the railroad commission, Miami Beach school board policy on married teachers, and a feature on Miami Life’s July 4th picnic and outing for orphaned children (Mayfair Theater and Musa Isle). Additional local columns, social notes, and advertisements appear throughout.
